summary: iter331 — Homepage 'Meet the Makers' fair-exposure rotation engine tested end-to-end (backend + frontend + admin edit flows). Backend pytest: 12/12 passing (main suite 6/6 + extras 6/6 covering admin auth gate, public no-auth, cadence-switch daily/weekly, HTTP-layer impression idempotency, never-featured + founder-boost scoring, bio-removal eligibility toggle). Frontend homepage renders <MeetTheMakers> with exactly 4 article cards matching the API window; each card carries data-testid='home-meet-makers-card-<slug>'. Admin card renders on /admin/dashboard?tab=settings with all 12 required testids present and 12 preview rows (4 featured + 8 up-next); UI edits fire PATCH (verified via GET config after edit) and update preview live. Regression guard: CURATED_SLUGS is fully gone from MeetTheMakers.jsx. FIXED one integration bug — see below.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED by test agent — fetchHomepageRotationConfig / updateHomepageRotationConfig / fetchHomepageRotationPreview in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js were calling http.get/patch without an Authorization header. The shared `http` axios instance has no request interceptor, so admin JWT was never sent → backend returned 401 → HomepageRotationCard stayed stuck at 'LOADING ROTATION…' forever. Added explicit `Authorization: Bearer ${localStorage.cm_admin_jwt}` header to all three helpers, matching the pattern used by other admin helpers already in the same file.

action_items: Consider a global axios request interceptor on the shared `http` instance that auto-attaches `Authorization: Bearer ${localStorage.cm_admin_jwt}` for any request whose URL starts with `/admin/`. Multiple admin helpers currently repeat the same header boilerplate — the missing header on the three iter331 helpers was easy to overlook because the pattern isn't enforced anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: Fair-exposure scoring in _score_maker() is deterministic and cleanly separated from IO (score = pure function of maker doc + cfg + now). Tie-break tuple (impressions, slug) makes ordering stable across runs. Good.

_record_homepage_feature() correctly guards on last_period_key stored in system_state so a burst of visitors never inflates impression counts within the same ISO-week / UTC-day — verified with 5 rapid HTTP GETs returning exactly 1 increment.

PATCH validation on /admin/homepage-rotation/config: unknown keys → 400, cadence not in {weekly,daily} → 400, window clamped to 1..12, excluded_slugs lowered + deduped + trimmed. All exercised by pytest.
MeetTheMakers.jsx self-hides via `if (items.length === 0) return null;` — good defensive UX when eligible_total drops to zero.

HomepageRotationCard integration bug found + fixed: three admin helpers omitted Authorization header on the shared axios `http` instance. Similar pitfall lurks elsewhere — a request interceptor would eliminate the class.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after applying integration fix — homepage renders 4/4 expected cards; admin card renders 12/12 testids + 12 preview rows; window edit + toggle + exclusion save all propagate to backend

Rotation config + state docs (system_state.homepage_rotation_config, homepage_rotation_state) were reset to defaults after every test; final cleanup verified: state=0 residual, config=0 residual, makers with lingering homepage_impression_count/last_homepage_featured_at = 0. No production maker docs mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend admin route is /admin/dashboard, not /admin. The HomepageRotationCard is mounted deep in SettingsTab.jsx (right after HeroHeadlinesCard) — Playwright must scroll it into view AND wait ≥5s after JWT is set in localStorage for the preview fetch to complete (three sequential requests: config → preview + one on demand). Card first renders in a 'LOADING ROTATION…' skeleton with data-testid='homepage-rotation-card' present but no inner testids — the 12 required inner testids appear only after the initial fetch resolves. If the inner testids are still MISSING after a long wait, that's a strong signal the admin JWT isn't being forwarded — check /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js:1516-1531 for the Authorization header.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE — /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js lines 1516-1521 (before fix): three new axios helpers (fetchHomepageRotationConfig, updateHomepageRotationConfig, fetchHomepageRotationPreview) used the shared `http` instance which has NO request interceptor to attach the admin JWT. Every call fell through to the backend without Authorization header → 401. The HomepageRotationCard component caught the error and displayed 'LOADING ROTATION…' skeleton indefinitely because the config never loaded. REPRODUCTION: seed localStorage with a valid admin JWT → open /admin/dashboard?tab=settings → scroll to the HomepageRotationCard → observe 4× 401 in devtools network tab + stuck loading state. MITIGATION APPLIED: added explicit `headers: { Authorization: Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('cm_admin_jwt') || ''} }` to all three helpers. Verified via full re-test: 12/12 testids appear, 12 preview rows populate, window edit persists to backend.
